title: BAI Organizes Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course provides advanced training for Indian badminton coaches, enhancing coaching standards across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: New Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic team championship, directly impacting Indian state teams and players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and procedures for participating teams.

title: Women’s Doubles Pair Changed for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This change affects the composition of India's potential women's doubles team for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification has been issued regarding a change in the women's doubles pair selected for the final trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Player Eligibility and Qualified List for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This announcement details the players who are eligible and have qualified for the final selection trials for India's World Junior Championships squad.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the player eligibility criteria and the list of players qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior players compete in U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
